750060701.text: That big lunk isn't going to start getting up, is it...

750060702.text: There'll be trouble if it does, but there's only one way through... Do I have to dig a path from on top to get around it? How long will that take...

750060705.text: #Well, aren't you bold, {M#lad}{F#lass}? Listen good, alright? Your youth means you've still got chances to make mistakes aplenty, but... W—Wait, where'd you come fr—

750060707.text: #Whoa, {NICKNAME}, what did you do to her? That wasn't some sorta invisible attack, was it?

750060601.text: Huh. I didn't think you'd be able to fend them off with those thin limbs of yours...

750060602.text: #Don't underestimate {NICKNAME}! {M#He's}{F#She's} taken way bigger things out than that!

750060604.text: Hmm, looks like roping you in was the right choice. Hehe... Ah, guess I've got a good eye, eh?

750060605.text: And here I thought you were going to compliment me!

750060606.text: Haha, I'll bet you've received lots of that, what with your strength and all. Just let poor Chikya get her share too, would'ja?

750060607.text: Look at the pictures on these walls. We've come to the right place!

750060608.text: Now, according to the ancient scrolls... We need to continue onward.

750060609.text: Let's get moving! Err, not too fast, though... Gotta have some care for the wounded — and by "wounded," I mean "me"!

750060401.text: So is this how a Spiritway looks when illuminated?

750060402.text: The ancient woven scrolls said that when the dim path lights up, it will be like a bonfire being roused once more into a blaze... and they weren't exaggerating.

750060403.text: Ah, right! You're back at last. You alright over there, Paimon?

750060407.text: Well, still not getting you there, but it seems you're uninjured too.

750060408.text: #And finally, {NICKNAME}... Eh, I knew you'd be fine, {M#lad}{F#lass}. You've got a bright future ahead of you, after all!

750060409.text: Some concern would have been nice all the same...

750060410.text: Eh, that would be unnecessary. The only thing you need is the "trust" of others, and you should be proud of that.

750060411.text: Seriously, though, this place is frighteningly full of liquid phlogiston. I was concerned for a moment there that you'd not come back.

750060412.text: Couldn't have returned on my own power with this bad back, after all. If you'd failed to return, I'd have turned into jerky over here, without ever having found that cure-all elixir!

750060414.text: What's wrong, Chikya? What's with that sudden look?

750060415.text: I just remembered that when tidying up ancient scrolls previously, I did spot an account of our ancestors swimming in lava.

750060416.text: At that time, I thought, "Swimming in liquid phlogiston? Madness!" Reckoned it was some wild storyteller's yarn, I did.

750060417.text: Well, now that you think about it, those were probably...

750060421.text: It's hard to imagine why anyone would draw that, but yeah, just thinking about it gives me the heebie-jeebies.

750060422.text: No wonder my friend gave me a pained look, like one looking at some emotionally-warped humanoid monster, when I told that story as a joke.

750060423.text: We drifted apart thereafter. Gah, that was one of my only friends, you know?

750060424.text: Anyway, never mind. Let's head back to the tribe and talk there instead. This whole "friends" business should start looking up once the Sage of the Stolen Flame's gift returns with us in glory!

750060203.text: Well, it had better be. I mean, an open door would mean that our path to the great treasure is long gone!

750060204.text: Huh. You do have a point there, Chikya!

750060205.text: ...Huh, to think that it was exactly as those woven scrolls and texts concerning them stated. What do you think? See that <color=#00E1FFFF>Phlogiston Engraving</color> right there by the door?

750060207.text: That's right. You're a quick one, little fella. Sharp-eyed, too. Researchers have said that Saurian visual acuity differs by species...

750060208.text: Saurians are generally further-sighted than humans are, though from this distance, anyone from the tribe who isn't a visually impaired old lady could spot this Phlogiston Engraving.

750060209.text: So this shining thing is what you call a Phlogiston Engraving, Chikya?

750060211.text: Wait, you've been adventuring in Natlan, but you've never heard of Phlogiston Engravings?

750060215.text: The origin of Phlogiston Engraving, narrowly speaking, comes from the days when Natlan was still ruled by a Pyro Dragon, who caused humanity to exist only in primitive tribes.

750060216.text: In those days, only the dragons could use phlogiston. But the Sage of the Stolen Flame, Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, risked life and limb to steal the flaming seed of it from the great volcano.

750060217.text: As such, humans began imitating the way dragons controlled the substance, creating a language by which humanity could exert that same control. This is the basis of modern Natlan's phlogiston usage.

750060218.text: The results of that are Phlogiston Engravings, like the one you see before you right now. Magnificent, isn't it? It's still intact even after all these years, still visible to the naked eye!

750060213.text: Your acting could use some work, although I'm not sure what sort of training could help you...

subQuests.subQuestName: Integrate the Unveiling Script(s) into the Phlogiston Engraving

750061801.text: And it's no big deal even if you don't find the Unveiling Script. The important thing is to watch your step!

750061802.text: Sure, a "one step at a time" approach is slower than most, but better to take each step with care, than with haste!

subQuests.subQuestName: Investigate the mechanism in the center

750060801.text: #J—Just one moment, {M#lad}{F#lass}. You seem rather strong...

750060803.text: #Whoa, {NICKNAME}, what did you do to her? That wasn't some sorta invisible attack, was it?

750060809.text: That was my back acting up. I've been stooping for a good long while, trying to observe that mechanism, and I stood up too fast. Pretty sure way to bring the pain, is what it is.

750060810.text: Used to be that it'd only flare up when I'd turn my back at a specific angle, but these days, one careless move leaves me in a world of hurt for a good long while.

750060811.text: #And just so you know, it's pain o'clock right now, so... Gah! Try to understand this suffering adult, would'ja, {NICKNAME}?

750060812.text: And what about you two? I mean your names...

750060813.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and this lil' Tepetlisaurus here is {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

750060814.text: I see, I see. In that case, I guess I'll call myself...

750060815.text: "Call yourself"? What, are you gonna give us a fake name?

750060816.text: Well, a person's gotta be on their guard while on a walkabout, don't they? Bah. And here I was going to give you my love rival's name. A young'un, she is, and energetic too — and worst of all, she's got a healthy back!

750060817.text: But forget it. That would be unfriendly competition — if you take my meaning. So have my real name instead: Chikya.

750060819.text: Heh, and aren't you a cute little fella? You're calling my name, I know it. Anyway, you can call me Big Sis Chikya — not Aunt Chikya though. That one I forbid.

750060808.text: #"Gusto"? What in tarnation is that? You're a braggart and a half, aren't you, {M#lad}{F#lass}?

750062201.text: Paimon was just about to say that this place was getting hotter the deeper in we got, but she sure didn't expect this whole place to be filled with lava!

750062202.text: #Careful, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! If you slip, that might just be the end of you...

750062204.text: Huh, now that you mention it, floaty little Paimon's the safest here!

750062205.text: Hehe, that's just one of the reasons Paimon's awesome, you know!

750062206.text: They say that those whose heads get too big wind up floating away...

750062207.text: Paimon's always floating anyway... But that didn't sound like a compliment.

750062209.text: You're a real bright spark, Paimon, you know that?

750062210.text: That... didn't sound like a compliment either, Chikya. Anyway, never mind all that!

750062211.text: This is the thing we were looking for, right? Hmm, it just looks like a clay ring with phlogiston patterning on it...

750062212.text: Do you think this one's valuable, by any chance?

750062213.text: Very much so... In fact, it's probably worth a large sum of Mora. But its real worth lies in its ability to open the path to the Upper {RUBY#[D]Hanan Pacha}Sanctum.

750062214.text: You've seen the islands floating in the sky, haven't you?

750062215.text: You mean the ones above the lake...

750062216.text: That's right. We call those the Upper {RUBY#[D]Hanan Pacha}Sanctum, due to their inaccessibility by either humans or Saurians.

750062217.text: They say that the "legendary elixir that heals all wounds" can be found there, in fact!

750062218.text: For people like us, who are constantly in conflict. That is a pure land of peace, a utopia created by the very first human to use phlogiston.

750062219.text: #And now it's time for a question, class. What was the name of that sage who, in the past, stole the flaming seed of phlogiston? {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

750062221.text: Very enthusiastic, but I don't think I heard you right!

750062223.text: #Alright, now then. Your turn, {M#lad}{F#lass}. What's your answer?

750062225.text: #Close, but not quite! It's Waxaklahun Ubah Kan. Shame about that, but it's minus 10 points from you, {M#lad}{F#lass}!

750062228.text: Anyway, we usually call him the Sage of the Stolen Flame, which is easier by far.

750062229.text: Some also call him a madman or a lunatic, but I'd call those compliments as well. He did do some very impressive things regardless, after all.

750062230.text: He stole the flaming phlogiston seed from the giant dragon and created the Upper Sanctum using that power, before teaching it to everyone in the tribes.

750062231.text: This is also, or so the ancient scrolls say, where humans first began practicing with phlogiston.

750062232.text: And this special Spiritdoor is a sort of trial. Activating this door will grant you access to the Spiritway that leads to the Upper Sanctum...

750062234.text: While I don't know what you're saying, yes, that's where the elixir is. Legend has it that it is a gift given by the Sage to those who pass the trial.

750062236.text: H—Huh, so that's the story... What's the trial like, then?

750062238.text: Nah, it's fine, I've seen the Phlogiston Engraving on this Spiritdoor enough times to sear it into my memory...

750062239.text: "If you wish to open this path, seek three Unveiling Scripts."

750062240.text: Hehe, I mean, drawing info directly from Phlogiston is impressive, but I'd personally put more stock in my graphic language comparisons.

750062241.text: It seems like this Spiritdoor already has an Unveiling Script embedded into it. See? A third of it has already been lit up...

750062242.text: So we just need to find the remaining two Scripts... Wait, didn't you two find them on our way here already?

750062244.text: Ah, you truly do have a bright future ahead of you. I didn't think you'd have such foresight. Even I, one hailing from the Masters of the Night-Wind, one who works with Iktomisaurs every day, must confess my shock.

750062245.text: In that case, let us integrate the Unveiling Scripts into the Phlogiston Engraving, just like before.

750062227.text: Very good. You memorized it after hearing it only once, did you? I see great things in your future, I do.

750060301.text: Paimon was just about to say that this place was getting hotter the deeper in we got, but she sure didn't expect this whole place to be filled with lava!

750060336.text: H—Huh, so that's the story... What's the trial like, then?

750060338.text: Nah, it's fine, I've seen the Phlogiston Engraving on this Spiritdoor enough times to sear it into my memory...

750060339.text: "If you wish to open this path, seek three Unveiling Scripts."

750060340.text: That's right, pretty much the same as before. We just need to find three Scripts this time!

750060341.text: Hehe, I mean, drawing info directly from phlogiston is impressive, but I'd personally put more stock in my graphic language comparisons.

750060342.text: It seems like this Spiritdoor already has an Unveiling Script embedded into it. See? A third of it has already been lit up...

750060343.text: So we just need to find two more!

750060345.text: Argh, my back's aching again... I'll wait for you here while you find those Unveiling Scripts, alright?

750060346.text: #This place is very dangerous, so keep your eyes peeled, {M#lad}{F#lass}!

750060327.text: Very good. You memorized it after hearing it only once, did you? I see great things in your future, I do.

subQuests.subQuestName: Integrate the Unveiling Script(s) into the Phlogiston Engraving
Ride the Spiritway back to ground level

750060501.text: As expected, the Spiritdoor below is connected to the one in these ruins, such that the passage may extend into the skies.

750060502.text: The woven scrolls record rightly — ah, I'm so proud of myself for believing in them!

750060504.text: #Yes, yes, and you're awesome for cooperating with me, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. Heh, what an adorable little fellow you are.

750060505.text: How would you like to jump ship over to me, hmm? Three square meals of one Grainfruit guaranteed.

750060507.text: Now, don't you go looking down on the Grainfruit, it's a real hit amongst Saurians, and it's healthy for them, too.

750060511.text: Haha, I'll take that as a no, then. Ah, to be so close — I'm getting a little envious.

750060512.text: #We were around when {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} first opened his eyes... You didn't have a chance to start with.

750060513.text: That so, that close, huh... That might make for a very painful goodbye if that time should come, though.

750060515.text: Alright. We're about to reach the Upper Sanctum, but, uh... Let me take five real quick. Goodness, my back hurts.

750060516.text: Has it always been that way?

750060517.text: Oh, come on, it's not that bad. You know, you leave yourself open to tricks by constantly taking people so seriously.

750060518.text: If anything, my back pain's decreased mysteriously since meeting you.

750060519.text: I wonder what that is... Is there something special about your body, and would that work with a piece of it of any size, like, say, a thumb?

750060520.text: Would you mind giving one to me? I'd give you mine in exchange.

750060509.text: Well, you miss every shot you don't take, you know?

750061901.text: "If you wish to open this path, seek three Unveiling Scripts."

750061001.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}? Did you find the key text we need? Don't worry, there's no rush. The walls around us might help you find something.

750061002.text: #Look on the bright side, {M#lad}{F#lass}. You've already saved us a day's worth of time. So really, there's no need to hurry!

750060903.text: Well, it had better be. I mean, an open door would mean that our path to the treasure is long gone!

750060904.text: Huh. You do have a point there, Chikya!

750060905.text: ...Huh, to think that it was exactly as those woven scrolls and texts concerning them stated. What do you think? See that <color=#00E1FFFF>Phlogiston Engraving</color> right there by the door?

750060908.text: Saurians are generally further-sighted than humans are, though from this distance, anyone from the tribe who isn't a visually impaired old lady could spot this Phlogiston Engraving.

750060909.text: So this shining thing is what you call a Phlogiston Engraving, Chikya?

750060911.text: Wait, you've been adventuring in Natlan, but you've never heard of Phlogiston Engravings?

750060915.text: The origin of Phlogiston Engraving, narrowly speaking, comes from the days when Natlan was still ruled by a Pyro Dragon, who caused humanity to exist only in primitive tribes.

750060916.text: In those days, only the dragons could use phlogiston. But the Sage of the Stolen Flame, Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, risked life and limb to steal a flaming seed of it from the great volcano.

750060917.text: As such, humans began imitating the way dragons controlled the substance, creating a language by which humanity could exert that same control. This is the basis of modern Natlan's phlogiston usage.

750060918.text: The results of that are Phlogiston Engravings, like the one you see before you right now. Magnificent, isn't it? It's still intact even after all these years, still visible to the naked eye!

750060913.text: Your acting could use some work, although I'm not sure what sort of training could help you...

750069601.text: Ugh, it's moving after all! Gah, my bad feelings always turn out true, don't they...

750069904.text: Ah, there we go! That's a door! Is that the one you're talking about?

750069906.text: Ah, there we go. A Spiritdoor and Spiritway, shimmering on the edge of reality — just what we're looking for!

750069908.text: #C'mon, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, you help out too! Just let Paimon and {NICKNAME} know if you see any glowy patterns, 'kay?

750069950.text: Haha, so this is the Spiritway... That was quick. I wasn't expecting this experience.

750069951.text: We took all this time to get to our destination, and "whoop," it took us all the way back in an instant. Fascinating.

750069952.text: If you ask me, the Pyro Archon should be placing this stuff everywhere!

750069953.text: Have you never entered a Spiritway before?

750069954.text: Well, I've always lived within my tribe's bounds, and we have phlogiston-saturated winds nearby that can blow us high into the sky over there...

750069955.text: Still, I feel like these Spiritways are slightly more fun.

750069999.text: You ride the Spiritway back to the surface...
